$comment: What r1r2-regression.mjs expects of each row, per mode. Data, not code, so the lead can tune `fixed` to the integrated 0.1.0-alpha.49.3 bundle without touching the attacks.

outcome: vulnerable = the attack had its effect (a forged or self-made acceptance opened a gate or was reported as accepted, a secret reached a response or another host); protected = it had none; works / broken = a compatibility row; skipped = not exercised on this platform.
codes: when given, at least one of these error codes must appear in the refusal of the gated step (envelope code, errors[].code, or the text).
integrity: when given, at least one of these per-subject integrity statuses must be reported for the attacked subject (inspect or status).
labels: when given, every listed approval label must be present on the result with exactly this value.
residual: the tier for which the row stays open by design (BRIEF-COMMON threat tiers); a residual row passes when it is observed as stated, never claimed closed.
